reserves.name: USDC deployed through Morpho lending and Curve liquidity strategies
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Origin OUSD Vault strategies using Morpho and Curve

reserveReview.rationale: Origin states that OUSD became 100% USDC-backed after the November 2025 simplification and deploys the collateral across Morpho lending and Curve liquidity provision. The reviewed current disclosure does not publish a fixed strategy allocation, so the prior 90/10 Morpho/Curve estimate was replaced with one aggregate USDC protocol-position basket.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current Origin OUSD collateral and strategy disclosure; strategy weights undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No reserve exposure is unlinked: the full basket is USDC collateral. Origin identifies Morpho and Curve as the complete strategy set but does not publish current per-strategy weights in the reviewed disclosure.
